decision: Close unweighted exact source-head subset transfer without variants. It requires 26 of 32 heads, has an active projection cost 11.55 times the current compact attention, and still misses held-out RMSE; the strict complete-decomposition integrity tolerance also misses. Authorize a materially different within-head value/output factorization review that preserves all source attention patterns while deriving a single minimum pooled internal rank from source weights. Do not retry head-count selection.
claim_boundary: Negative read-only source-head subset evidence only; no weights copied, installed, retained, or promoted and no model, runtime, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
